_comment: Native cadences (minutes) of each data product. Used by validate_timestep.py to validate the requested training step and to compute per-product minute filters. null = continuous (no minute filter required). Update this file if you add a new data source or change an existing one. NOTE: the validator's floor is the max of all non-null cadences here; comment out (rename with leading underscore) the products you are not using if they would otherwise raise the floor beyond what you need.
